messages:
maria_fin: Heads up — found 3 customers overcharged on yesterday's invoices. Looks like seat counts got mis-attributed by the usage aggregation job after Friday's deploy. One example: CUST-1821 shows 12 seats in Stripe export but invoice line shows 1 seat.

maria_fin: Quick paste from the raw CSV/JSON we ingest:```
{"customer_id":"CUST-1821","usage":{"seats":"12"},"total_tokens":12345}
```

maria_fin: Our parser expects top-level 'seat_count' numeric. If it doesn't find it we fall back to 1 — which explains the 1-seat line item. :grimacing:

alex_devops: yikes. Which job name / service is responsible for that aggregation?

sanjay_engineering: usage-aggregator v2 (deployed Fri 02:10 UTC). The export schema change was in the export PR — we changed to a nested usage object and renamed the field. Parser didn't get updated.

emma_ops: Can we pause invoice finalization for today's run? If we re-run the aggregator and recompute invoices we can avoid sending incorrect charges.

billing-bot: invoice-finalize job paused by @emma_ops at 2026-03-01T12:12:34Z :white_check_mark:

sanjay_engineering: I'll push a hotfix to the parser to accept both top-level 'seat_count' and nested 'usage.seats' and then re-run backfill for affected accounts. Plan: patch -> run backfill for last 7 days -> reopen/adjust invoices in NetSuite -> final check.

sanjay_engineering: Quick test command I'll run on prod (read-only first):
```bash
./scripts/usage-aggregator --mode=preview --since=2026-02-23 --accounts=CUST-1821,CUST-1999
```

alex_devops: After preview looks good, run with --recompute and include --ns-apply to push adjusted lines to NetSuite. I'll monitor job queue and rate limits.

maria_fin: Please hold off on customer comms until we confirm fixes. We'll prepare a short note if invoices have to be reissued.

sanjay_engineering: Opening PR now — will also add a regression test for both schema variants and an alert if future exports change schema without a flag.

billing-bot: backfill job started (job id: bf-20260301-77). Notifying ops channel for visibility.

emma_ops: Thanks team. Can we also add a check in the nightly reconcile that flags >20% seat_count delta compared to previous invoice? That would've caught this. :eyes:

sanjay_engineering: good idea — adding that to the reconcile rules. Also adding a webhook schema validator so we fail fast on unknown payload shapes.

alex_devops: Hotfix deployed to parser service (v2.0.1) on canary. Preview results matched expected seat counts for the two sample accounts. Will kick off full backfill in 5m.

maria_fin: once backfill completes, I'll verify 3 affected invoices and mark them for reprovisioning/credit memos as needed. Thanks. :thumbsup:
